court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Registrar Anna University and Others … Respondent(s).
advocates: For Respondent(s) : Ms. Jaseema for M/s. Ajmal Associates for R 1
prayer: PRAYER: The Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking the issuance of a Writ of a Certiorarified Mandamus calling for all the records pertaining to the selection of the 4th and 5th respondents in the selection list dated 13-11-2025 on the file of the 1st and 2nd respondents and quash the same and consequently direct the 1st and 2nd respondent to issue posting order to the petitioner for the post of Assistant professor in the Mechanical Engineering, Department.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

P.T. Asha, J.:— When the matter was taken up for hearing today, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner sought permission of this Court to withdraw this Writ Petition with liberty to file a fresh Writ Petition. To that effect, he has also made an endorsement in the Court bundle.

2. Recording the submission and the endorsement made by the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, this Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn, with liberty granted to the petitioner to file a fresh Writ Petition. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, the connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
